observation: WorkingTreeSnapshotter treated a path as Git-backed only when <root>/.git was a directory. A linked git worktree stores .git as a file pointing to the main repository metadata, so edits executed in a real linked worktree silently produced unavailable working-tree evidence even though git status and git rev-parse worked normally. Building the self-edit dogfood probe reproduced the boundary directly: the safe isolated place for agent-loop to mechanically edit its own HEAD was exactly the repository shape the snapshotter rejected.

evidence.summary: Before this fix, src/Edit/WorkingTreeSnapshotter.php returned WorkingTreeSnapshot::unavailable() when <root>/.git was not a directory, before asking Git for status. The pre-fix implementation is present in the PR base commit ab59c60225e0d81959c9d59677fc8e61fe7eab7a.

All three composer-ci matrix jobs passed with the new regression test that creates a detached linked worktree, confirms .git is a file, edits a tracked source file, and requires WorkingTreeSnapshotter to report the observed path.

evidence.command: GitHub Actions CI run 31238145054: Agent-loop shapes itself / Let agent-loop edit itself in an isolated worktree
evidence.summary: The real agent-loop edit --runner=mechanical path passed against agent-loop's own tracked SelfEditProbe inside a linked worktree. The probe required changed_files_source=git_status_diff, exactly one changed source file, mechanical routing, zero model tokens/tool calls, and external_model_invoked=false.

evidence.command: GitHub Actions CI run 31238145054: Installed release-set dogfood
evidence.summary: The installed release-set gate remained green after the worktree evidence fix.

hypothesis: Repository evidence should be discovered by invoking Git, not by predicting Git's on-disk metadata shape. Any precondition that assumes .git is a directory will incorrectly reject linked worktrees and can silently weaken edit evidence.
validated_conclusion: WorkingTreeSnapshotter must let git rev-parse/status determine whether a path is a usable working tree. Linked worktrees are valid evidence sources even though .git is a file. Self-edit dogfood should keep using an isolated linked worktree because it exercises the real edit path without mutating the PR checkout and makes this repository-shape invariant executable.
